cases.name: issue1517_tube_ends_union_checked
cases.note: #1517 / WR-579: a bicycle frame's top tube (r 16, (-150, 0, 820) to (600, 0, 860), seam at -y) united with its seat tube (r 16, from (0, 0, 300) towards (-150, 0, 820), 3.7e-4 short, seam at +y), each SmApiCreateCylinder turned about Z for its seam, about Y onto its axis and moved to its base, as crates/solidcore/tests/wr579_near_coincident_tube_ends_join.rs builds them. At the default fixes (upstream behaviour) this compares the port with the C++ on the defect: upstream's SmProtoEdge::Resolve keeps an edge whole past a third vertex definition of its own proto vertex and the union fails; Kernel::fixes.proto_edge_splits_at_captured_vertices splits it. Compares the union's status and SMLib's capi check (level 2) of the result.
